nodes.label: EMA 50/200 Real EUR/USD H1 Chart
nodes.description: Candlestick chart showing EMA 50 (blue) and EMA 200 (red) applied to real EUR/USD H1 data over 200 candles. Price trends downward from ~1.1775 to ~1.1600, illustrating EMA crossover and bearish trend context.

nodes.label: EMA 50
nodes.description: Exponential Moving Average with period 50, shown in blue on the EUR/USD H1 chart. Faster-reacting line that crosses below EMA 200 indicating bearish momentum.

nodes.label: EMA 200
nodes.description: Exponential Moving Average with period 200, shown in red on the EUR/USD H1 chart. Slower trend-baseline line remaining above EMA 50 throughout the downtrend.

nodes.label: EUR/USD H1 Real Market Data
nodes.description: Real EUR/USD price data on H1 timeframe, 200 candles, showing a bearish trend from approximately 1.1775 to 1.1600.

nodes.label: EMA Death Cross Signal
nodes.description: Visual demonstration of EMA 50 crossing below EMA 200 (death cross) on real EUR/USD H1 data, confirming bearish trend signal.
